name: Italy
description: Italy is a unitary parliamentary republic and a founding member of the European Communities. Its economy pairs northern industrial districts — machinery, automotive, fashion — with a vast cultural-heritage tourism sector and persistent southern structural challenges. A G7 economy in the eurozone, it balances manufacturing excellence with high public debt and demographic aging.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Italy's actor space from city-state mercantile networks and IRI state holdings through postwar industrial districts to family-owned multinationals and EU fiscal supervision.

works.title: Industrial District Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of machinery, textile and food clusters, cooperative banks, and export consortia binding small-firm districts to global buyers.

works.title: Regional Autonomy Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of twenty regions with asymmetric autonomy, the north-south productivity divide, and logistics corridors to central Europe.
